title: LDAP-authenticated actor attribution for CRM service commands
summary: Dev12 binds Relationship CRM service actor attribution to the platform LDAP identity contract while keeping authentication, role authorization, CRM command policy and Odoo provider authority distinct.
invariants: LDAP owns authentication attribution and principal/group state; the Odoo provider never receives LDAP credentials.
An authenticated LdapSession and ACTIVE LDAP principal are required before a CRM service actor can be constructed.
CRM actor role is admitted only through explicit local principal/group bindings; LDAP principalType is not a role and is never promoted implicitly.
The semantic LDAP principal ID becomes Relationship CRM Service actorId so command attribution is stable across providers.
Relationship CRM Service remains command, idempotency, persistence and Queue Fabric authority after LDAP actor resolution.
Missing, unauthenticated, inactive or unbound principals fail closed before a CRM service envelope is emitted.
procedure: Authenticate through the platform LDAP service and retain its LdapSession.
Build explicit OdooRelationshipCRMLdapRoleBinding entries for approved CRM principals/groups.
Resolve the actor through OdooRelationshipCRMLdapActorResolver and call envelopesForLdapCallProjection.
Submit resulting envelopes only through Relationship CRM Service.
